Package threepl.netlist.xilinx

Class RamBlock

java.lang.Object
threepl.netlist.xilinx.RamBlock
public class RamBlock extends Object
This class contains parameters describing a registered memory block. It is used when allocating and creating block RAMs. device type element amin amax dmax dmin XC2S 1 RAMB4 8 12 16 1 XCV 1 RAMB4 8 12 16 1 XC2V 1 RAMB4 8 12 16 1 2 RAMB16 9 14 32+4 1 XC2VP 1 RAMB4 8 12 16 1 2 RAMB16 9 14 32+4 1 XC3S 2 RAMB16 9 14 32+4 1 XC4V 2 RAMB16 9 14 32+4 1 XC5V 3 RAMB18 10 14 16+2 1 ++ 4 RAMB36 10 15 32+4 1 ++ XC6S 5 RAMB8BWER 9 13 16+2 1 ++ 6 RAMB16BWER 9 14 32+4 1 ++ XC6V 3 RAMB18 10 14 16+2 1 ++ 4 RAMB36 10 15 32+4 1 ++ XC7 3 RAMB18 10 14 16+2 1 ++ 4 RAMB36 10 15 32+4 1 ++ ++ address inputs padded at LSB end

  • Method Details

    • RAMB

      public void RAMB()
      Construct a dual port RAMB4. Only the following combinations of widths are allowed - 
       address data
   8      16 (256 deep x 16 bits)
   9       8 (512 deep x 8 bits)
  10       4 (1024 deep x 4 bits)
  11       2 (2048 deep x 2 bits)
  12       1 (4096 deep x 1 bit)
